## jsoup-1.15.3
**jsoup 1.15.3** is out now, and includes a security fix for potential XSS attacks, along with other bug fixes and improvements, including more descriptive validation error messages.

Details:

- [Security advisory](https://github.com/jhy/jsoup/security/advisories/GHSA-gp7f-rwcx-9369)
- [Release notes](https://jsoup.org/news/release-1.15.3)
- [Download](https://jsoup.org/download)
